questions.question:
The growth rates of companies A and B in a table are multiples of 5 from 5% to 30%.

Question: Is the growth of A higher than that of B?
I. A grew by 25% and B grew by less than 20%.
II. A grew by more than 10%.

Which of the following is correct?
options: Statement II alone is sufficient, but statement I alone is not
Statement I alone is sufficient, but statement II alone is not
Both statements together are needed; neither alone is sufficient
Even both statements together are not sufficient
questions.explanation: Statement I alone fixes the answer as Yes. Statement II alone leaves several answers possible (for example Yes and No). Taken together they fix the answer as Yes. Answer: Statement I alone is sufficient, but statement II alone is not.

questions.question:

II. The cost price was more than ₹150.

options: Even both statements together are not sufficient
Statement I alone is sufficient, but statement II alone is not
Statement II alone is sufficient, but statement I alone is not
Both statements together are needed; neither alone is sufficient
questions.explanation: Statement I alone leaves several answers possible (for example 200 and 50). Statement II alone leaves several answers possible (for example -40 and -35). Taken together they still leave several answers possible (for example 50 and 0). Answer: Even both statements together are not sufficient.
